question: Should OpenClaw sponsor channels.msteams.accounts and channels.msteams.defaultAccount as the permanent public contract for running multiple Teams bot identities in one gateway?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible, but it creates durable configuration, credential-selection, setup, and persisted-state semantics that automation cannot approve as product policy.

options.title: Sponsor the account contract
options.body: Accept the proposed Plugin SDK-aligned account model after confirming legacy single-bot and default-account upgrade guarantees.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Request a smaller initial surface or different inheritance rules before accepting the permanent Teams configuration API.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep single-bot Teams behavior and close or defer the PR until the product direction has an explicit sponsor.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the account contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed Plugin SDK-aligned account model after confirming legacy single-bot and default-account upgrade guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion already routes product review here, and recent configuration/documentation history makes this the strongest available decision-owner signal.
